system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We use a generic decision-making zero-shot preamble at the beginning of (i), and a short separator prompt at the beginning of (ii)
system_prompt_style.note: Preamble fixed across tasks; prompt assembled by src/prompts.py with config flags (legal actions, chain-of-thought).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: We do not include an environment task description (e.g., the rules of tic-tac-toe) in the preamble.
env_context_strategy.note: No repository/environment context beyond observations and demonstrations; no navigation tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the current trajectory starts with a single initial state and grows as more state-action pairs are observed (up to a maximum of 100 steps)
context_compaction.note: Context grows monotonically; context size is managed by choosing number of demonstrations, not by compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: We investigate four observation formats: ASCII, FEN, PGN, and RGB
observation_format.note: observation_type flag selects txt or image; default in README example is txt.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: We post-process the model outputs by removing all the leading/trailing white spaces and only consider the text after the keyword “Action:”
tool_call_format.note: Closest value: the action is plain text after an 'Action:' keyword, not JSON and not a tool call; no tool-calling API is used.

tool_count.evidence_quote: In every evaluation step, we condition the model on the current context, upon which it generates an action that we feed to the environment.
tool_count.note: No tool definitions are exposed; the only output is an environment action string.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: In every evaluation step, we condition the model on the current context, upon which it generates an action that we feed to the environment.
edit_primitive.note: No file editing; environments are games/control tasks.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schemas at all; action format is described by hand-written prompts/legal action lists.

protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A components in the 23-file source tree.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: we may use a chain-of-thought (Wei et al., 2022) style prompt at the very end of (ii) asking the model to provide a reasoning before proposing an action
planning_granularity.note: use_chain_of_thought config flag; no stored plan object.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: In every evaluation step, we condition the model on the current context, upon which it generates an action that we feed to the environment.
human_in_loop.note: Fully automated evaluation loop; no confirmation step.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the current trajectory starts with a single initial state and grows as more state-action pairs are observed

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: For each evaluation episode we uniformly subsample (without replacement) the demonstration episodes (for the frozen part of the prompt) from a precomputed pool of up to 1000 distinct demonstrations.
long_term_memory.note: Fixed expert demonstrations are static few-shot data, not cross-run memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: We always evaluate 100 episodes with different initial conditions (each episode is evaluated individually) and report the average score.
state_persistence.note: No resume path described in the evaluation loop.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We only perform very minimal postprocessing (see Section 2.1) of the LM generations to obain the action
self_verification.note: Environment reward is computed but never shown to the model; no critique/test/lint stage.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If a model fails to generate a legal action, we uniformly sample one of the legal actions
retry_policy.note: Illegal actions are replaced by a random legal action rather than retried.

rollback.evidence_quote: We then concatenate the resulting next environment state (prepended with the action that produced it) to the growing context.
rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism; environment steps are irreversible.

termination_condition.note: Episodes also terminate on environment termination (win/draw/loss).

cost_controls.note: Context size is controlled by the number of demonstrations, but no token budget, routing or caching mechanism is described.

timeouts.note: Only step caps; no time limits in the config dataclasses.

execution_isolation.note: Simulated environments run in the local Python process/conda env; Stockfish is a local binary.

filesystem_access.note: Relative to the local process boundary; the agent itself only emits environment actions, no filesystem access.

network_policy.evidence_quote: We perform an evaluation via closed-source APIs and thus have little control over how the data is processed
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism; model APIs are called over the network.

permission_model.evidence_quote: In every evaluation step, we condition the model on the current context, upon which it generates an action that we feed to the environment.
permission_model.note: Legal-action checking exists but illegal actions are replaced, not authorised/blocked by a policy.

tracing.note: Scores are aggregated per episode; no structured per-step trace format is documented.

replayability.note: replay_episode is a control experiment requiring exactly 1 demonstration; API models may be updated so results are not exactly reproducible.

eval_hooks.note: The repo is itself the LMAct benchmark with its evaluation loop and expert demonstrations.

guardrails.evidence_quote: If a model fails to generate a legal action, we uniformly sample one of the legal actions
guardrails.note: Illegal-action validation before the environment step is the only control.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a battery of simple interactive decision-making tasks: playing tic-tac-toe, chess, and Atari, navigating grid worlds, solving crosswords, and controlling a simulated cheetah
target_domain.note: Games and control tasks; not SWE/web/GUI computer use.
